descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we believe that simply reporting code issues is not sufficient. To truly level up the quality of the world's software, we must empower millions of developers to fix them automatically. With over 400,000 enterprises relying on our products, we hold a unique lever to shape how software is built.

Recent breakthroughs in AI have made autonomous remediation a reality, but the industry faces a major hurdle: Trust . Enterprises cannot automate what they do not trust. As a Software Engineer in the CodeGen squad, you will build the critical backend components for Verified Autonomous Remediation . You will work within a high-performing team to turn research prototypes into reliable, production-grade features that test and validate AI-generated code. You will help us close the "Trust Gap" by delivering robust software that just works.

What you will do

• Build Features for the "Unified Remediation Engine". You will implement the backend logic that powers our remediation efforts. You will write clean, reliable code (Java/Python) that routes requests between deterministic QuickFixes and LLM agents, ensuring features are delivered reliably within our existing framework.

• Implement Production-Grade Agent Logic. You will take concepts from the Research team and "productionize" them. You will write the specific workflows that allow the Agent to read CI/CD errors, attempt fixes, and iterate until the build is green.

• Own Your Code from Local to Cloud. You are responsible for the full lifecycle of the features you build. You will deploy your services to AWS, monitor their health (metrics/logs), and troubleshoot production issues to ensure high availability for our users.

• Secure & Optimize Execution. Working within our existing sandboxing framework, you will implement the runners and isolation layers required to execute AI-generated code safely. You will ensure your implementation is secure and efficient.

• Collaborate & Share Knowledge. You will be an active member of the squad, reviewing PRs, documenting your work, and sharing knowledge with peers. You will act as a subject matter expert for the specific components you own, ensuring the team moves forward together.

Experience and qualifications

• Solid Backend Engineering (3+ years). You have a track record of building and maintaining backend systems. You write clean, testable code and care about software craftsmanship.

• Polyglot Versatility (Java & Python). You are comfortable with one of the core languages: Java (for integration with the Core Sonar ecosystem) or Python (for AI/Agent logic). You pick up new tools and syntax quickly.

• Cloud Operations (AWS). You understand how your code runs in the cloud. You have experience with AWS (Lambda, ECS, or similar) and are comfortable with deployment pipelines, logging, and basic infrastructure monitoring.

• Systems Fundamentals. You understand how different services talk to each other (REST, queues, async processing). You know how to debug a distributed system when things go wrong.

• Interest in AI/LLMs. You are excited about the potential of AI in software development. Experience using LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic) is a plus, but a willingness to learn how to integrate them into backend workflows is essential.

• Ownership Mindset. You don't just "take tickets." You own the delivery of your tasks, raising risks when necessary and ensuring your work meets high quality standards before it reaches production.

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Our website is the front door to the Sonar ecosystem. It is where developers and organizations discover our products, and where our marketing and data systems connect to the outside world. You will work across both sides of that: building the UI people see and the integrations they do not.

You will start by contributing across the full stack and progressively own entire domains end-to-end:

• UI delivery: Build accessible, performant components from design specs for a growing number of websites that serve a global audience across 7 languages.

• Analytics & tracking: Own how we instrument the websites (event tracking, data layer, tag management) so that marketing and product teams can measure what matters.

• Marketing integrations: Own the backend connections between our frontend and our business systems (forms, lead capture, automation workflows) ensuring data flows accurately from the browser to internal tools.

We have built our development workflow around AI-assisted coding and we expect you to push that further. AI handles more of the repetitive work over time, which means your role expands into higher-impact territory, not less.

What you will do

•
Build UI components from Figma designs, collaborating closely with designers to iterate until it’s right.

•
Write and maintain content model migrations as our CMS structure evolves.

•
Implement tracking requirements from the marketing team, including new events, data layer updates, and tag configuration.

•
Build and maintain the server-side logic that powers forms, API routes, and integrations with external marketing systems.

•
Partner with the SEO and content teams on structured data, metadata, and internationalization.

•
Write tests, read code reviews, provide honest feedback and ship code.

•
Leverage AI coding tools daily, as a core part of your engineering workflow.

•
4+ years of professional web development: Hands-on expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js is required.

•
Quality-minded: You write tested code and care about what ships to production. Experience with modern testing tools and CI workflows.

•
Comfortable on the backend: You have built API routes, handled form submissions server-side, or worked with external service integrations. You’re not afraid of a server loader.

•
Curious about web analytics: Experience with tag management (GTM) or analytics instrumentation.

•
AI-fluent: You actively use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot...) in your daily workflow and look for ways to go further.

•
Pragmatic and Autonomous: You prioritize impact over technical novelty. You do not wait for direction, you investigate, form an opinion, take action, and iterate as you learn.

Nice to have:

•
Experience with a framework (Remix, Next.js, React Router framework mode), Tailwind CSS, a headless CMS, or Storybook.

•
Experience with analytics tools (other than Google): Mixpanel, Fullstory

•
Experience with CRMs: SalesForce, Marketing Cloud

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we believe that simply reporting code issues is not sufficient. To truly level up the quality of the world's software, we must empower millions of developers to fix them automatically. With over 400,000 enterprises relying on our products, we hold a unique lever to shape how software is built.

Recent breakthroughs in AI have made autonomous remediation a reality, but one major hurdle remains: Trust . Generative AI makes mistakes, and enterprises cannot automate what they do not trust. This is where you come in. As a Senior/Staff Engineer, you will architect the backend for Verified Autonomous Remediation , a sophisticated Agentic workflow that doesn’t just generate code, but rigorously tests and validates it using Sonar’s analysis engine. You will tackle the hard engineering problems required to close the "Trust Gap."

What you will do

• Architect the "Unified Remediation Engine". You will design the high-throughput decision logic that powers our remediation efforts. You will build the backend services that intelligently route requests between deterministic instant QuickFixes, LLM-based reasoning fixes, and complex Agentic flows.

• Build Robust Agent Architecture. You will contribute to the Sonar Remediation Agent code, transitioning research concepts to a resilient, high-scale production service. You will implement self-healing workflows where the Agent iteratively fixes the code it produces until the build is green.

• Solve the "Sandboxing" Problem. You will architect the secure execution environments required to run untrusted, AI-generated code. You will design the isolation layers that allow Agents to iterate on code improvements without compromising our infrastructure.

• Engineer for Reliability & Safety. You will implement critical safety mechanisms, like Circuit Breakers to automatically reroute requests to the proper engine when acceptance rates drop. Crucially, you will own the cost/performance trade-off, ensuring our AWS architecture scales to millions of events without letting token costs spiral.

• Act as a Technical "Force Multiplier". Beyond building systems, you’ll mentor the squad through design reviews and collaborate with the Research team to ensure our agent is not just state-of-the-art, but production-safe.

Experience and qualifications

• Strong Backend & Cloud Expertise. You have 8+ years of experience building scalable resilient systems. You are strong in AWS architecture and know how to design for high availability and low latency with cost in mind.

• Polyglot Ecosystem (Java & Python). You are comfortable operating in a hybrid environment: Java for deep integration with the Core Sonar analysis engine and Python for the AI/Agent reasoning layer. You should be strong in one and capable in the other. We make use of various LLM tools, and are looking for people not afraid of different languages.

• Systems Thinking. You understand that "AI" in production is mostly "Systems Engineering." You know how to handle asynchronous event-driven architectures, manage queues, and design sandboxed execution environments to run untrusted code safely.

• AI & LLM Integration. You have practical experience building applications that orchestrate LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or hosted open models). You understand the backend complexity of RAG, context window management, and prompt engineering at scale.

• Data-Driven Mindset. You care about the "Why." You want to build telemetry pipelines that distinguish between "Bad UX" and "Bad Code," focusing on the metrics that matter.

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Notre équipe opère à travers des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous bougeons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE:
• Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.
• Obsédé par la qualité.
• Délibérer dans nos décisions.
• Efficace comme une seule équipe. Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. • Soyez un acteur clé de l'ingénierie dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et le fonctionnement des contrôles de sécurité et de l'automatisation sur nos plateformes d'identité, terminaux et services informatiques de base.

• Concevoir et maintenir des intégrations de surveillance de sécurité, d'alerte et de SIEM qui nous donnent une visibilité en temps réel dans l'identité, le paramètre et les risques SaaS.

• Surveillance de la sécurité, alerte & SIEM Propriété : Travailler avec l'équipe Sécurité de l'information, concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des règles d'alerte, des tableaux de bord et des runbooks sur nos plateformes SIEM et de journalisation, en mettant l'accent sur les signaux d'identité, d'accès et de sécurité SaaS. • Endpoint Defense In Depth: Architecte et implémente nos systèmes de défense multicouches (p. ex. Crowdstrike, Cyberark, Cloudflare, politiques de navigateur sécurisé), équilibrage des risques par rapport à la facilité d'utilisation en coordination avec l'équipe Sécurité de l'information.
• Identity Platform & Access Automation : Construisez et maintenez l'automatisation de nos plates-formes d'identité (p. ex. SSO, fourniture SCIM, politiques d'accès en groupe, flux de travail du cycle de vie) en partenariat avec la Sécurité de l'information. Mettre en oeuvre des garde-corps et des politiques en tant que code d'identité, en veillant à ce que les changements soient examinés, testés et vérifiables avant d'atteindre la production.
• Infrastructure comme code et contrôles de sécurité comme code : Utilisez IaC et la gestion de configuration (p. ex. Terraform, Ansible, ou similaire) plus les langages de script (p. ex. Python, Go) pour déployer et gérer l'outillage de sécurité, les intégrations et les politiques. Traiter les contrôles de sécurité (par exemple, l'enregistrement, la numérisation, le durcissement, la gestion secrète) comme des artefacts logiciels qui peuvent être mis en version, testés et roulés en toute sécurité.
• Observabilité et intégration avec les opérations informatiques de base : veillez à ce que l'enregistrement, les mesures et le traçage des systèmes de sécurité (IdP, VPN, protection des paramètres, SaaS critique) soient robustes, précis et intégrés à notre pile d'observation. Intégrer les événements de sécurité et les automatisations avec l'ITSM et les workflows de gestion des incidents, permettant un routage, un tri et une résolution rapides.
• Réponse aux incidents et génie post-incident : Participer à la rotation sur appel pour les services de sécurité et d'identité pertinents. Diriger ou contribuer à des examens post-incident, transformer les causes profondes en changements d'ingénierie préventive (nouvelles alertes, automatismes, garde-corps ou documentation) qui réduisent le MTTR et la récurrence.
• Opérations de sécurité activées par l'IA : Utilisez l'outil d'IA (p. ex. assistants basés sur LLM, plateformes d'automatisation) pour accélérer le triage d'alerte, l'enrichissement et l'investigation, tout en maintenant les humains dans le contrôle des décisions. Déterminer les possibilités d'intégrer l'IA dans les flux de travail des opérations de sécurité et de TI (p. ex., renseignements sur les menaces et corrélation d'alerte) et aider à les mettre en oeuvre de façon sécuritaire et efficace. Expérience et qualifications

• Expertise en gestion de l'identité et de l'accès : Expérience pratique d'exploitation des IdP et des systèmes IAM à l'échelle (p. ex. Okta, Azure AD, ou similaire), y compris SSO, MFA, gestion du cycle de vie, et les politiques des moins favorisés. Expérience de la conception et de la mise en oeuvre de l'offre et de la fourniture automatisées (p. ex. SCIM, intégrations HRIS, modèles d'accès par groupe et par rôle).
• SIEM, Logging & Observability : Expérience éprouvée avec SIEM et plateformes d'observation (p. ex. ELK/EFK, Spunk, Datadog, ou similaire), y compris les règles de détection de l'écriture et de l'accordage, les tableaux de bord de construction et le travail avec l'ingestion de log à grande échelle. Confort de travailler avec les SLI/SLO et les budgets d'erreurs pour les services essentiels, et les utiliser pour guider les priorités de durcissement et d'automatisation.
• Automatisation et infrastructure en tant que code : Forte expérience des outils de gestion de configuration (p. ex. Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible ou similaire) et des langages de script/programmation (p. ex. Python, Go, ou équivalent) pour automatiser les tâches de sécurité et opérationnelles. Track record de conversion de travail manuel et opérationnel répétitif en capacités d'automatisation et de libre-service fiables.
• Mise en œuvre des contrôles de sécurité : Expérience de la mise en œuvre et de l'exploitation des contrôles de sécurité comme code : analyse de vulnérabilité, bases de configuration, gestion secrète (p. ex., HashiCorp Vault), rotation des clés et gestion des certificats.
• Gestion des incidents et collaboration interfonctionnelle : Expérience démontrée participant ou menant une intervention en cas d'incident, une analyse des causes profondes et un suivi post-incident en partenariat avec les Opérations de TI, Sécurité et Ingénierie. Fortes compétences en communication en anglais, capables d'expliquer des sujets complexes de sécurité et d'exploitation aux publics techniques et non techniques.
• Fluidité de l'IA : Confortable grâce à l'utilisation d'outils modernes de l'IA (p. ex. assistants basés sur LLM, cadres d'automatisation) dans le cadre du travail quotidien d'analyse, de production de contenu et d'automatisation des flux de travail. Capacité de raisonner sur l'endroit où l'IA est et n'est pas approprié dans la sécurité et les opérations , équilibrer la vitesse avec le risque et le contrôle. Commentaires supplémentaires Ce rôle est basé à Genève. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de considérer les candidats qui ne veulent pas être à Genève, mais nous sommes prêts à déplacer le bon candidat. Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran. Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse embauche@sonarsource.com . Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début. Nous ne soutenons pas actuellement les candidats au visa aux États-Unis. Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

Chi è Sonar? Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella revisione e nella verifica del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA. Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:
• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci. Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:
• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.
• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Descrizione della posizione Siamo ancora all'inizio del nostro viaggio di crescita e stiamo continuamente introducendo nuovi processi, tecnologie e strumenti. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Essere un contributo fondamentale per la progettazione, l'implementazione e il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura di rete globale di Sonar che spazia in tutte le sedi degli uffici e negli ambienti cloud, garantendo una connettività veloce, sicura e affidabile per ogni SonarSourcer e ogni servizio.
• Parti chiave proprie della nostra architettura WAN, LAN, SD-WAN e DNS, assicurando che i servizi di rete siano resilienti, performanti e allineati alle esigenze di un'organizzazione in rapida crescita e distribuita a livello globale.
• Progettare e mantenere le funzionalità di monitoraggio della rete, avvisi e osservabilità che ci danno visibilità in tempo reale nella salute della rete, le prestazioni e la postura di sicurezza in tutti i siti e interconnessioni cloud.
• Partner con Product Engineering, Information Security e Infrastructure Engineering per garantire che i controlli e la segmentazione di rete sicuri siano profondamente e senza soluzione di continuità integrati nei flussi di lavoro di ingegneria, non bloccati.
• Utilizzare e campione AI tooling per rendere le operazioni di rete più efficienti -- da triage di avviso e rilevamento di anomalia alla pianificazione della capacità e gestione della configurazione.
• Aiuta a definire e migliorare come misurare l'affidabilità e le prestazioni dei nostri servizi di rete (SLIs/SLO, budget di errore e dashboard), rendendo la salute della rete visibile e attuabile agli stakeholder. Cosa farai ogni giorno:
• Architettura di rete & Ingegneria: Progettazione, implementare ed evolvere l'infrastruttura di rete di Sonar in tutte le sedi di uffici e ambienti cloud. Valutare e implementare tecnologie che migliorano l'affidabilità, il throughput e l'esperienza degli utenti riducendo al contempo la complessità operativa.
• Fortigate Firewall Architecture & Network Segmentation: Configurare, amministrare ed evolvere la nostra architettura del firewall Fortigate, inclusi set di regole, politiche di segmentazione di rete, tunnel VPN e configurazioni ad alta disponibilità. Assicurarsi che le politiche firewall priorità funzionalità e prestazioni, mantenendo una forte postura di sicurezza, in coordinamento con il team di sicurezza delle informazioni.
• Servizi di rete DNS, DHCP & Core: Possedere la progettazione, l'automazione e l'affidabilità dei servizi di rete di base (DNS, DHCP, NTP, IPAM). L'implementazione di policy-as-code e automazione per garantire che i cambiamenti siano esaminati, testati e verificabili prima di raggiungere la produzione.
• Monitoraggio della rete, Alerting & Observability: Progettazione, implementare e mantenere dashboard di monitoraggio della rete, regole di avviso e runbook diagnostici. Avvisi costantemente sintonizzati per ridurre il rumore, migliorare la fedeltà del segnale e allineare con SLOs per servizi di rete critici e interconnessioni.
• Infrastrutture come Code & Network Automation: Utilizzare IaC e la gestione della configurazione (ad esempio, Terraform, Ansible, o vendor-native automation) e linguaggi di scripting (ad esempio, Python, Go) per distribuire e gestire dispositivi di rete, configurazioni e politiche. Tratta le configurazioni di rete come artefatti software che possono essere versioneti, testati e rirotolati in modo sicuro.
• Multi-Cloud Networking & Hybrid Connectivity: Progettare e gestire reti cloud attraverso GCP, Azure e AWS (VPC, VNets, peering, gateway di transito, endpoint privati, cloud-native load balance) e connettività ibrida (Web-to-site VPN, interconnessioni dedicate) per garantire una comunicazione sicura e a bassa latenza tra i carichi di lavoro on-premise e cloud.
• Incident Response & Post-Incident Engineering: Partecipa alla rotazione on-call per i servizi di rete. Condurre o contribuire a recensioni post-incidenti, trasformando le cause della radice in cambiamenti di ingegneria preventiva (nuovi avvisi, automazioni, aggiustamenti di capacità, o documentazione) che riducono MTTR e ricorrenza.
• AI-Enabled Network Operations: Utilizzare gli strumenti AI (ad esempio, assistenti basati su LLM, piattaforme AIOps) per accelerare il triage di avviso, il rilevamento di anomalia e l'analisi della causa radice, mantenendo gli esseri umani nel controllo delle decisioni. Identificare le opportunità di incorporare l'IA nei flussi di lavoro delle operazioni di rete (ad esempio, previsioni di capacità, rilevamento della configurazione della deriva) e contribuire a implementare questi in modo sicuro ed efficace. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Network Engineering & Operations Background: Esperienza pratica significativa (4-7 anni) nell'ingegneria di rete, nelle operazioni di rete, o ruoli strettamente correlati in ambienti moderni e veloci (ad esempio, SaaS, Enterprise IT, reti aziendali multi-sito o infrastruttura cloud-native).
• Routing, Switching & WAN Competenza: Profonda esperienza pratica progettazione e funzionamento di ambienti LAN/WAN aziendali, compresi i protocolli di routing (BGP, OSPF), commutazione (VLAN, STP, MLAG/VPC), e SD-WAN tecnologie. Esperienza con architetture di rete multi-sito e gestione del traffico globale.
• Fortigate Firewall & Network Security: Prove esperienze di configurazione e gestione delle piattaforme firewall Fortigate/FortiOS, tra cui gestione delle policy, VPN (IPSec e SSL), SD-WAN e configurazioni ad alta disponibilità. Esperienza di applicazione della segmentazione di rete e principi di accesso alla rete zero-trust. La familiarità con altre piattaforme firewall (ad esempio, Palo Alto, firewall cloud-native) è un vantaggio.
• Multi-Cloud Networking: Esperienza pratica con cloud networking su GCP, Azure e AWS, tra cui design VPC/VNet, peering, gateway di transito, bilanciamento del carico nativo cloud e connettività ibrida (VPN, Direct Connect/Cloud Interconnect/ExpressRoute). L'esperienza di gestione dell'infrastruttura di rete su più provider cloud è fortemente preferita.
• Automation & Infrastructure as Code: Forte esperienza con strumenti e framework di automazione della rete (ad esempio, Ansible, Terraform, Nornir, NAPALM, o API native del fornitore) e con linguaggi di scripting/programming (ad esempio, Python, Go, o equivalente) per automatizzare il provisioning della rete e la gestione della configurazione. Tracciare il record di conversione manuale, ripetitivo lavoro operativo in automazione affidabile e capacità self-service .
• DNS, DHCP & IPAM: Esperienza pratica che opera e automatizza i servizi di rete di base a scala aziendale, con un focus sull'affidabilità, l'auditability e l'integrazione con l'automazione delle infrastrutture più ampia.
• Network Monitoring & Observability: Esperienza comprovata con piattaforme di monitoraggio e osservabilità della rete (ad esempio, strumenti basati su SNMP, Datadog, ThousandEyes, LibreNMS o simili), inclusi cruscotti di costruzione, avvisi di sintonizzazione e lavoro con SLIs/SLOs e budget di errore per i servizi di rete critici.
• Gestione degli incidenti & Collaborazione interconfessionale: Esperienza dimostrata che partecipa o guida risposta agli incidenti, analisi delle cause radicali e follow-through post-incident in collaborazione con IT Ops, Sicurezza e Ingegneria. Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese, in grado di spiegare complessi argomenti di rete e operativi sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico.
• AI Fluency: Confortevole utilizzo di moderni strumenti AI (ad esempio, assistenti basati su LLM, framework di automazione) come parte del lavoro quotidiano per analisi, generazione di contenuti e automazione del flusso di lavoro. Capacità di ragionare su dove l'IA è e non è appropriato nelle operazioni di rete, bilanciando la velocità con il rischio e il controllo. Ulteriori commenti Questo ruolo è basato a Ginevra. Non siamo in grado di considerare i candidati che non vogliono essere a Ginevra, ma siamo disposti a trasferire il candidato giusto. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Attualmente non sosteniamo i candidati del visto negli Stati Uniti. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:
• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:
• Committed to our customers and community.
• Obsessed with quality.
• Deliberate in our decisions.
• Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description We are still at the beginning of our growth journey and are continuously introducing new processes, technologies, and tools. In this role, you will:
• Be a pivotal engineering contributor to the design, implementation, and operation of Sonar's global network infrastructure spanning all office locations and cloud environments, ensuring fast, secure, and reliable connectivity for every SonarSourcer and every service.
• Own key parts of our WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, and DNS architecture , ensuring that network services are resilient, performant, and aligned with the needs of a rapidly growing, globally distributed organization.
• Design and maintain network monitoring, alerting, and observability capabilities that give us real-time visibility into network health, performance, and security posture across all sites and cloud interconnects.
• Partner with Product Engineering, Information Security, and Infrastructure Engineering to ensure secure network controls and segmentation are deeply and seamlessly integrated into engineering workflows , not bolted on.
• Use and champion AI tooling to make network operations more efficient -- from alert triage and anomaly detection to capacity planning and configuration management.
• Help define and improve how we measure the reliability and performance of our network services (SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and dashboards), making network health visible and actionable to stakeholders. What You Will Do Daily:
• Network Architecture & Engineering : Design, implement, and evolve Sonar's network infrastructure across all office locations and cloud environments. Evaluate and deploy technologies that improve reliability, throughput, and user experience while reducing operational complexity.
• Fortigate Firewall Architecture & Network Segmentation : Configure, administer, and evolve our Fortigate firewall architecture, including rule sets, network segmentation policies, VPN tunnels, and high-availability configurations. Ensure firewall policies prioritize functionality and performance while maintaining a strong security posture, in coordination with the Information Security team.
• DNS, DHCP & Core Network Services : Own the design, automation, and reliability of foundational network services (DNS, DHCP, NTP, IPAM). Implement policy-as-code and automation to ensure changes are reviewed, tested, and auditable before reaching production.
• Network Monitoring, Alerting & Observability : Design, implement, and maintain network monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, and diagnostic runbooks. Continuously tune alerts to reduce noise, improve signal fidelity, and align with SLOs for critical network services and interconnects.
• Infrastructure as Code & Network Automation : Use IaC and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or vendor-native automation) plus scripting languages (e.g., Python, Go) to deploy and manage network devices, configurations, and policies. Treat network configurations as software artifacts that can be versioned, tested, and rolled back safely.
• Multi-Cloud Networking & Hybrid Connectivity : Design and operate cloud networking across GCP, Azure, and AWS (VPCs, VNets, peering, transit gateways, private endpoints, cloud-native load balancing) and hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPN, dedicated interconnects) to ensure secure, low-latency communication between on-premises and cloud workloads.
• Incident Response & Post-Incident Engineering : Participate in the on-call rotation for network services. Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews, turning root causes into preventative engineering changes (new alerts, automations, capacity adjustments, or documentation) that reduce MTTR and recurrence.
• AI-Enabled Network Operations : Use AI tooling (e.g., LLM-based assistants, AIOps platforms) to accelerate alert triage, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis, while keeping humans in control of decisions. Identify opportunities to embed AI in network operations workflows (e.g., capacity forecasting, configuration drift detection) and help implement these safely and effectively. Experience and qualifications
• Network Engineering & Operations Background : Significant hands-on experience (4-7 years) in network engineering, network operations, or closely related roles in modern, fast-paced environments (e.g., SaaS, enterprise IT, multi-site corporate networks, or cloud-native infrastructure).
• Routing, Switching & WAN Expertise : Deep practical experience designing and operating enterprise LAN/WAN environments, including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), switching (VLANs, STP, MLAG/VPC), and SD-WAN technologies. Experience with multi-site network architectures and global traffic management.
• Fortigate Firewall & Network Security : Proven experience configuring and administering Fortigate/FortiOS firewall platforms, including policy management, VPN (IPSec and SSL), SD-WAN, and high-availability configurations. Experience implementing network segmentation and zero-trust network access principles. Familiarity with other firewall platforms (e.g., Palo Alto, cloud-native firewalls) is a plus.
• Multi-Cloud Networking : Hands-on experience with cloud networking across GCP, Azure, and AWS, including VPC/VNet design, peering, transit gateways, cloud-native load balancing, and hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect/Cloud Interconnect/ExpressRoute). Experience managing network infrastructure across multiple cloud providers simultaneously is strongly preferred.
